title: Windows Down
premise: Lillith and Rubella drive through a car wash with the windows down. The giant brushes come in and scrub them. They roll out with foam beards and foam wigs, perfectly calm.
visual: Car wash exit. Their low black supercar half out of the tunnel, foam overflowing from every window. Both women with tall foam hairdos and foam beards, red lips, flat faces. A huge blue spinning brush still poking in the driver's window. The attendant's jaw is on the ground.
characterLean: The Two stay deadpan; the world is silly. Fits the car / road-trip stretch (they have the car).

motion: 6-8s. They roll in. Wet sponge slaps. Foam rises. Brushes enter the windows and scrub. They roll out and stop. Lillith turns on the inside wipers. Rubella blows foam off her lip once.
notes: They never close the windows and never comment. Generic supercar, no badge or brand.
